post.description: Accepts, validates, and persists allocation feedback from EVCharge-Opt. Enforces deterministic idempotency using allocation_run_id and request payload hashing. Returns HTTP 201 for new submissions, HTTP 200 for identical duplicate retries, and HTTP 409 when the same allocation_run_id is reused with a different payload.

200.description: Idempotent duplicate: allocation_run_id already exists and payload hash matches. Returns the original feedback record with is_duplicate=true.

400.description: Validation failure: scenario_id mismatch, interval not aligned to originating forecast, or other semantic validation error.

example.detail: Submitted scenario_id 'x' does not match forecast scenario 'y'.

404.description: Originating forecast or submitted station ID not found.

409.description: Conflict: allocation_run_id was previously submitted with a different payload. Reusing the same run identifier with modified content is prohibited.

example.detail: Allocation run 'opt_run_20261026_001' was already submitted with different content. Reusing the same run identifier with modified data is prohibited.
